mapper.select: SELECT country_id AS countryId, country_name AS countryName, -- 한글 이름 country_en_name AS countryEnName, -- 영어 이름 iso_code AS isoCode, continent, img FROM country WHERE country_name = #{name} OR country_en_name = #{name}
SELECT country_id AS countryId, country_name AS countryName, country_en_name AS countryEnName, iso_code AS isoCode, continent, img FROM country WHERE iso_code = #{isoCode}
SELECT continent, img AS countryImg FROM country WHERE iso_code = #{isoCode}

SELECT c.country_id AS countryId, c.country_name AS countryName, c.country_en_name AS countryEnName, c.iso_code AS isoCode, a.level_value AS levelValue FROM country c LEFT JOIN alert_level a ON c.country_id = a.country_id WHERE 1=1
AND a.level_value = #{levelValue}
AND (c.country_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.country_en_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.iso_code LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY c.country_name

SELECT c.country_id AS countryId, c.country_name AS countryName, c.country_en_name AS countryEnName, c.iso_code AS isoCode, c.img as countryImg, c.latitude as countryLatitude, c.longitude as countryLongitude, a.level_value AS levelValue FROM country c LEFT JOIN alert_level a ON c.country_id = a.country_id WHERE c.country_id = #{countryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE country SET country_name = #{countryName}, country_en_name = #{countryEnName}, iso_code = #{isoCode}, latitude = #{countryLatitude}, longitude = #{countryLongitude} WHERE country_id = #{countryId}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_level) AS totalCountries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_level WHERE level_value IS NULL) AS safeCountries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_level WHERE level_value = '여행금지') AS bannedCountries FROM dual
SELECT country_id AS countryId, country_name AS countryName, country_en_name AS countryEnName, iso_code AS isoCode, continent, img FROM country ORDER BY country_name
SELECT country_id AS countryId, country_name AS countryName, country_en_name AS countryEnName, iso_code AS isoCode, continent, img FROM country WHERE country_id = #{id}
